beats.summary: Andy initiates an end-of-day tradition by playing and singing 'Closing Time' to signal the office closing.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Every office needs an end of the day tradition. Something to tell you the day is over.

beats.summary: Pam humorously admits she still doesn't know the lyrics to 'Closing Time' despite hearing it many times.

Erin (Laughs and shrieks):
Andy: Closing time.
